title: Sarnath recognised as UNESCO World Heritage Site
summary: India now has 45 World Heritage Sites according to the UNESCO website. The last addition or ‘inscription’ was in 2024, with the Maratha Military Landscapes located Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu.

title: Parliament Monsoon Session Day 6 LIVE: Opposition MPs protest demanding accountability for police action on students from Home Minister
summary: Both Houses adjourned till 12 p.m. amid Opposition sloganeering on use of brute force on students

title: NEET protest: Supreme Court says right to peaceful protest guaranteed, fixes hearing on police excesses on July 28
summary: CJI Surya Kant said that merely because a protest was underway, the police was not justified in using force

title: Oil mill gutted in massive fire in Kerala's Kozhikode
summary: None injured as mill was not operational at the time of the incident. The blaze reportedly originated from a copra drying unit operated with firewood

title: AMMA crisis: Four women members call for seizure of documents from Shwetha Menon’s panel
summary: Maala Parvathi, Ansiba Hassan, Usha Haseena, and Ponnamma Babu have urged Registrar of Co-operative Societies to seize books of accounts and financial documents that continue to be under the possession of the panel led by Shwetha Menon that had announced its resignation at general body meeting on June 21

title: Special Intensive Revision: AI used to detect 6.41 lakh anomalies in Bengaluru
summary: For the first time since the enumeration phase began, the Greater Bengaluru Authority has disclosed that there have been at least 6.41 lakh ‘logical discrepancies’ or anomalies within its jurisdiction

title: Amid UDF-LDF spat over Kerala finances, govt reminds departments of need for ‘austerity’ in Budget estimates
summary: Finance department repeats advice about dropping uneconomical schemes and 'perhaps deferment of certain measures, including maintenance expenditure, which can be postponed’

title: Madras High Court to hear PIL on Karur Devadanam land issue
summary: Litigant claims the department had lifted the ban on registration of those properties much to the disadvantage of four temples in Karur district
